title: I Live 500 Feet From A Bitcoin Mine. My Life Is Hell.
summary: A More Perfect Union report from a small Texas town next to a large Bitcoin mining facility, where residents describe constant noise and health problems. It looks at the political and corporate power behind the facility.
why: Linked in crypto-mining threads for its picture of what nearby residents endure, though some commenters treat it as a case of corporations overriding locals.

quote.text: gives a better visceral sense of what these people are dealing with
